Commentary.Commentary: The Dutch team celebrates and that ends the T20 World Cup Qualifier, 2019! Netherlands, Papua New Guinea, Ireland, Namibia, Scotland and Oman are the ones featuring in the 2020 T20 World Cup, along with the big guys. All the best to them. We take your leave, hoping to have your company for future events. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Netherlands skipper, Pieter Seelaar, says that he is very proud of his team. Adds that there were some questions raised about their chances but is happy to have won it outright, having shared the trophy with Ireland and Scotland in the earlier editions. Praises the experience of Cooper, Ackermann and ten Doeschate for seeing their team through. Is eager to go to Australia and believes that his team is well placed to do well over there. On Brandon Glover, Pieter says that the former impressed them in a club game back in Holland and to win the Man Of The Final award is impressive. Is looking forward to celebrate the win tonight and thanks the crowd for coming in large numbers to support. On PNG, Seelaar praises them, crediting them for stifling the batsmen, not giving easy runs away and showing the world that they belong.

Papua New Guinea captain, Assad Vala, accepts that it was not their day but believes that the team has done the country proved. Praises Ackermann and Cooper for showing them how to bat on this surface and hopes that his team can learn from them. Praises Damien Ravu for coming back strongly after being dropped midway in the tournament. On the learnings and the shortcomings, Vala is happy where the team is but wants his batsmen to work harder and get bigger scores.
NAMIBIA'S GERHARD ERASMUS HAS BEEN NAMED THE PLAYER OF THE TOURNAMENT.

NETHERLANDS' BRANDON GLOVER HAS BEEN NAMED THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. Says that this win is incredible after seeing so many months of hard work. On his performance tonight, Glover says that one has to do his job and it was more about rhythm, coming in, running in and hitting the right areas consistently. Says that he is very much looking forward to playing in Australia.
Time for the final presentation of the tournament. The match referee and the umpires get their medallions.

Ryan ten Doeschate says that it was very tough in the middle. Says that he could have got out a couple of times, so 150 would have been very difficult. Says that they believed they could  win the game, if they batted 20 overs, although, rues that final over which went for 22. Praises Papua New Guinea for not giving Netherlands any thing and says that it is always nice to beat that quirky team. On the tournament win, Ryan says that qualifying for the World Cup was a big thing but a win here is an icing on the cake. On the preparations for that tournament, Tendo says that he is not sure how Netherlands would go about things as a couple of young batters are coming up the ranks. Then says that there is still a year to go, so there is time to think about it.

Netherlands coach, Ryan Campbell, says that he is relieved with the win. Admits that there were plenty of issues internally but the group stuck together. Puts it down to the entire unit, with the seniors and the juniors gelling well. On the run chase, Campbell says that Netherlands' strength is to score 160 - Not 200, but 160 and for that, wickets in hand are needed and that is how the Dutch played. On the team selection, Ryan says that when he selected 5 fast bowlers for the Middle East, everyone questioned his selection but they did well. Now, he says, he might need 6 fast bowlers for Australia.
Time for a couple of quick chats.

As usual, Papua New Guinea bowled well. Ravu and Vala kept the pressure in the middle overs but towards the end, the others could not handle the pressure. One of the most consistent teams in this tournament, they have displayed their quality nicely.

A decent outing for the Dutch. The bowlers set it up, restricting PNG to 128, although 22 of those came in the final over. This tournament has shown us so many times that any total close to 130 or 140 can be defended. Netherlands did start off shakily, losing Visee early but Ben Cooper and later on, Colin Ackermann, ensured that there was no collapse. Towards the end, Ryan ten Doeschate's cameo helped.

The champions celebrate. Before the tournament, it was supposed to be one among Ireland, Scotland and the Netherlands to win but while that did prove to be correct, no one expected Papua New Guinea to qualify for the T20 World Cup, let alone make it to the final. The group has a moment for themselves, patting each other before breaking off.
SIX! Finishing it off in style! A length ball, around off, ten Doeschate waits for the slower ball to arrive and swings it cleanly over mid-wicket! NETHERLANDS WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
Around off, worked towards long on for a run to level the scores.
Full and wide outside off, Ackermann slaps it towards cover and takes a single. The throw comes in to the stumps at the bowler's end and then deflects away towards long on. A second is taken.
Down the leg side, ten Doeschate misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads past the keeper. Doriga himself runs after it towards fine leg and keeps the batsmen to a single.
A length ball, down the leg side, flicked towards square leg for a single.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
Outside off, swung off the inner half through mid on for a run. 9 needed from 12 balls now.
Another full toss, Vanua losing his radar, Ryan pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! LOVELY! A full toss outside off and ten Doeschate is set enough now to make use of that, driving it through the covers.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Around off, pushed towards long on again, for a run.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Norman Vanua is back on. 2-0-15-0 so far.
Outside off, placed straight to point. Bizarre over. A single, 4 dots and a six.

SIX! BOOM! That releases the pressure a bit. The ball is around the half volley mark and ten Doeschate goes after it. Down on a knee, fetching it from outside off and slogging it over mid-wicket. 18 needed from 19 balls now.
Landed outside off, cut straight to point.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Around off, played with soft hands towards point. Ackermann takes off for the single, is sent back, slips but recovers and gets back in time.
Full and around middle, played with soft hands wide of mid on for a single.
Nosaina Pokana returns. 2-0-17-1 so far.

FOUR! Off the edge and this helps too! A length ball outside off, ten Doeschate throws the kitchen sink at it but gets a thick outside edge. However, luckily for him, the edge flies through the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence! 13 from the over.
SIX! BLUDGEONED! How crucial is that hit? Ravu goes short and ten Doeschate pulls it massively into the crowd at mid-wicket! 29 more needed from 25 balls now.
A short ball, down the leg side, Ackermann looks to pull but is cramped for room. The ball takes the gloves and lobs in the air but is wide of the keeper.
Around off, pushed towards long on for a single.
WIDE. Tendo comes down the track and Ravu, anticipating that, bowls a bouncer. But gets it too high.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Damien Ravu gets a change of ends. 2-0-5-1 so far.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for another single. 4-0-31-0 for Amini.
On middle, pushed down to long on for one. 39 needed from 31 balls.

TOP EDGE, SAFE! Full and outside off, ten Doeschate comes down the track and looks to go inside out but the ball spins away and takes the top edge. Three men run after it - short third man, point and cover - but the ball eludes them. A single taken.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Full and around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Charles Amini returns. 3-0-26-0 so far.
Landed outside off, dabbed straight to short third man. Just 2 from the over. The Netherlands are feeling the pressure. Vala is done - 4-1-15-1. Another superlative effort.
Outside off, whipped straight to short mid-wicket.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, hitting the deck and then gripping away, Ackermann looks to drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to third man. A single taken.
Outside off, punched through the line, through the covers for a single.
Ryan ten Doeschate walks in at number 5, replacing Cooper.

OUT! Caught! Massive wicket. Set batsman falls and folks, we have a game on our hands. A short ball, outside off, Cooper swivels and pulls but it travels in the direction of the man at deep backward square leg. Lega Siaka over there, watches the ball carefully, judges it nicely, comes running in and takes a beautiful catch diving forward! Another good innings from Cooper ends. 47 needed from 45 now.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
A length ball, around middle, blocked from the crease back to the bowler.
Damien Ravu returns. 1-0-3-0 so far.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
Full and around off, driven straight back down the ground for a single.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full and around middle, pushed towards mid on.
SIX! Clean hitting. Full and around middle, Cooper comes down the track and flicks it over mid-wicket! 13 from the over!
Full and around middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
A short ball once more, pulled to deep mid-wicket for another single.
A long hop again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a hat-trick of braces.
Short this time, pulled to deep square leg for a couple.
Full toss, on middle and leg, paddled fine for a couple.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full and down the leg side, paddled fine for a couple.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.

FOUR! 'Catch it!' is the call but no one is there. Full and around off, Cooper just lofts it over the bowler and just about beats long off. That is just the 4th boundary conceded in 15 overs in the middle overs of this tournament by PNG!
Ripper! How good is that? Floated outside off, barely any pace, Cooper stays back to defend but the ball lands and then turns away past the outside edge!
Full and around off, flicked wide of short mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman goes after a wide one and misses.
SIX! That has gone all the way. Full and around middle, Cooper comes down the track and swings it cleanly over mid-wicket! There is a fielder in place but it goes well wide of him.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. A WICKET MAIDEN FOR VALA!
Full and around middle, pushed towards mid on.

Oh dear... how has he missed that? A full toss, outside off, Ackermann looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. Vala appeals but the umpire turns it down. Impact was outside off.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Beaten first up! Superb from the captain again. Landed around off, Ackermann looks to defend but the ball pitches, drifts away and then straightens, to beat the outside edge, squaring Colin up!
Colin Ackermann walks in at number 4, replacing O'Dowd.

OUT! Caught! Stunner, absolute stunner from Charles Amini! Boy, PNG are ecstatic. Does the game turn from here on? Tossed up, around off, O'Dowd goes back and looks to flick but cannot keep it down. The ball flies and at the same time, Charles Amini flies to his left. Superb acrobatic catch. 81 needed from 77 balls.
The skipper, Assad Vala, brings himself on.
Outside off, chipped over cover for a run.
BEATEN! Landed outside off, Max goes back to cut but the ball spins back in a long way, cramps O'Dowd for room, takes the inside edge and goes past the leg stump! Two runs taken.
Full and outside off, lofted wide of long off for a run.
Full and around off, Cooper gets a good stride to defend.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Full and around middle, Max looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Charles Amini to bowl his leg breaks.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. That is 43/1 in the Powerplay. Papua New Guinea were 30/3 at this stage.
Around middle, flicked towards square leg for a quick single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point this time.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Cooper slashes hard and cuts it to the point boundary!
FOUR! Up and over! Full and outside off, Cooper lofts it over mid off and gets it to the fence.
Full and down the leg side, O'Dowd looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball goes towards square leg and a leg bye is taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for one more.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside off, Max looks to cut but misses.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Damien Ravu to bowl now.
On a good length on leg, Cooper looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Cooper looks to flick but misses it.
Full delivery on off, Cooper drives it to covers.
On a length on leg, O'Dowd nudges it through square leg for a run.
On a length on off, O'Dowd guides it towards third man. The fielder in the deep misfields and concedes two runs.
Full delivery on middle, O'Dowd drives it back towards the bowler.
Full delivery on off, Cooper drives it through mid off. The batsmen cross ends.
Norman Vanua is into the attack.
Full delivery on middle, Cooper drives it through mid on. The fielder at long on does well to stop it before the ropes. The batsmen get three runs.
Full and wide outside off, O'Dowd looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which flies through the vacant slip cordon to the third man region. A single taken.
On a good length on leg, O'Dowd looks to flick but gets it off the pads.
Full delivery on off, Cooper drives it towards mid off. The batsmen take a run.
On a length on middle, Cooper nudges it to the leg side.
Length delivery on middle, O'Dowd flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
FOUR! Nice shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Cooper sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery on off, Cooper drives it back towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery on leg, O'Dowd plays a sweep towards square leg for a run.
Full delivery on middle, Cooper drives it through mid on. The batsmen cross ends.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Cooper flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery on off, O'Dowd drives it towards mid off for a single.
Max O'Dowd is the new batsman in. Sese Bau to bowl from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT! On a good length on off, Visee looks to loft it over mid off but gets early into the shot. It goes towards Norman Vanua who takes a comfortable catch. 11 runs and a wicket from the first over.
On a length on off, Visee taps it through point. The batsmen get two runs.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. Full delivery on off, Visee lofts it over covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Visee lets it go.
Length delivery on off, Visee punches it to point.
On a length on middle, Visee flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That is a poor start. Pokana starts with a short delivery well outside off, Visee takes it with both hands and cuts it over point for a boundary.

We are back for the chase. The Papua New Guinea players are out in the middle. Tobias Visee and Ben Cooper will open the batting for Netherlands. Nosaina Pokana will start the proceedings for Papua New Guinea.
